title: 第十三章凝气临门
novel_title: 扫地八十年，从宗门杂役飞升成仙
content_zh:
叶凡的肉身底子早超了这层次。

    境界跟不上，才显得灵气薄。

    现在丹药补进来，身体空了许久，来多少装多少。

    药力疯狂填入，经脉越撑越满。

    叶凡的双臂鼓起，皮肤下气血流动，比之前更有力。

    半个时辰过去，他身下的床彻底塌了。

    叶凡盘坐在断木板中间，身子纹丝不动。

    “这笔账记马得水头上！”

    他低声嘀咕。

    “要不是他催的急，我还能省张床。不过旧的不去新的不来，塌了正好睡地上接地气。”

    过了一会，锻体六阶的关口终于被推开。

    灵气涌入四肢。

    叶凡抬手握拳，掌心发出骨节响。

    力量涨的很明显。

    这不是九龙搬血带来的底子，而是境界重新补上后的完整战力。

    一转肉身，加锻体六阶灵气。

    配碎石拳和疾风飘叶。

    现在如果王二李四站在他面前，连试拳的资格都没有。

    叶凡表面波澜不惊，心里早乐开了花，总算有保命的本钱了。不过两个锻体六阶杂役，算不得什么。

    真正的麻烦，会从内门来。

    内门弟子哪怕派下来的只是狗腿子，修为也可能在锻体九阶，甚至凝气境。

    如果运气差点，来个凝气期的外门高手，那就更难受。

    天剑宗有规矩，锻体四阶能入外门。

    可外门里真正不做杂活、能安稳修炼的人，至少得凝气。

    凝气期的外门弟子，有住处，有月俸，有听讲资格，还能接宗门任务。

    锻体弟子，说白了仍是半个苦力，赚俩钢镚的苦力。

    叶凡现在刚进外门，连苦力里都算新人。

    别人真要踩他，连借口都不用费劲找。

    他看向剩下的丹药，还有最后一批。

    吃完最多再冲一阶，锻体七阶。

    距离九阶还差两阶。

    若按之前的计划，本来打算等上十天半个月的，但现在，他等不了几天。

    明天送来的新废丹，是关键。

    叶凡拿起丹药，掌心停了片刻。

    他现在体内药力已经堆的很满。

    可一想到马得水那张肥脸，他手上就没了犹豫。

    “你们要赶时间？行，那我陪你们赶。”

    丹药入口，轰的一下。

    这次药力比前几轮更乱。

    前面刚突破，体内灵气还没完全归位，新药力强行灌进去，立刻在经脉里冲撞。

    叶凡的肩膀一震，皮肤泛红，汗水成片往下流。

    他咬着牙没发出声音，只要经脉没断就炼。

    灵气在体内绕了一圈又一圈，丹药的药力不断被吞进去。

    可越往后，吸收越难。

    锻体六阶到七阶，对锻体境来说是个小门槛。

    跨过去，气血运转更快，拳脚威力会明显提高。

    跨不过去，药力只能卡在体内，过几日慢慢散掉。
content_en:
Ye Fan's physical body has already surpassed this level.

    If the realm cannot keep up, it will appear that the spiritual energy is weak.

    Now that the elixir has been replenished, the body has been empty for a long time, so it can take as much as it takes.

    The power of the medicine is crazily filling in, and the meridians are getting fuller and fuller.

    Mark's arms bulged, and the energy and blood flowed under his skin, becoming more powerful than before.

    Half an hour later, the bed beneath him completely collapsed.

    Ye Fan sat cross-legged among the broken wooden boards, his body motionless.

    "This account will be recorded immediately!"

    he muttered under his breath.

    "If he hadn't urged me so urgently, I could have saved a bed. But if I don't get rid of the old one, I won't get a new one. If it collapses, I can sleep on the ground to get a sense of comfort."

    After a while, the barrier to the sixth level of body training was finally pushed open.

    Spiritual energy flows into the limbs.

    Ye Fan raised his hand and clenched his fist, his palms making knuckle sounds.

    The strength increased obviously.

    This is not the foundation brought by the blood transfer in Jiulong, but the complete combat power after the realm is replenished.

    Once the physical body is transformed, the sixth level of spiritual energy is added to the body.

    Paired with gravel fist and flying leaves in the wind.

    If Wang Er and Li Si stood in front of him now, they would not even be qualified to try their fists.

    Ye Fan looked calm on the surface, but he was already happy in his heart. He finally had the capital to save his life. But two sixth-level body-forging handymen are nothing.

    The real trouble will come from the inner door.

    Even if the inner sect disciples are just losers, their cultivation level may still be at the ninth level of body training, or even the Qi Condensation level.

    If you are not very lucky and have an outer sect master in the Qi Condensation stage, it will be even more uncomfortable.

    The Tianjian Sect has rules, and those who have reached the fourth level of physical training can enter the outer gate.

    But those who really don't do chores in the outer sect and can cultivate stably must at least condense their Qi.

    Outer disciples in the Qi Condensation stage have a place to live, a monthly salary, the qualifications to listen to lectures, and can also take on sect tasks.

    To put it bluntly, a physical training disciple is still half a coolie, earning two steel coins.

    Ye Fan has just entered the outer sect and is considered a newcomer even among the coolies.

    If others really want to step on him, they don't even have to look for excuses.

    He looked at the remaining pills and the last batch.

    After eating, you can go up to one level and exercise to the seventh level.

    It is still two steps away from the ninth level.

    According to the previous plan, he originally planned to wait for ten days and a half, but now, he could not wait for a few days.

    The new waste elixir delivered tomorrow is the key.

    Ye Fan picked up the elixir and paused in his palm for a moment.

    His body is now very full of medicine.

    But when he thought of Ma Deshui's fat face, he no longer hesitated.

    "You want to be in a hurry? Okay, then I'll accompany you to catch up."

    There was a bang when the elixir entered the entrance.

    This time the potion was more chaotic than the previous rounds.

    Just after the breakthrough, the spiritual energy in the body has not yet completely returned to its original position. The new medicinal power is forcefully poured in and immediately collides in the meridians.

    Mark's shoulders shook, his skin turned red, and sweat flowed down in sheets.

    He gritted his teeth without making any sound, and practiced as long as his meridians were not broken.

    The spiritual energy circled around the body, and the power of the elixir was continuously swallowed.

    But the further back you go, the harder it is to absorb.

    The sixth to seventh level of body forging is a small threshold for the body forging realm.

    When you step over it, your energy and blood will flow faster, and the power of your fists and kicks will be significantly increased.

    If you can't cross it, the medicine will only stay in your body and slowly dissipate in a few days.
title_en: Chapter 13 Condensing Qi at the Door
